question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Collect every ELF DT_NEEDED library name, sort strings by ascending code-unit order, join with one LF byte and no trailing LF, then SHA-256 those UTF-8 bytes.

answer_format.syntax: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; no prefix, whitespace, or explanatory text

oracle_cmd: printf %s "$(readelf -d -W gf_c_imports.bin | sed -n 's/.*(NEEDED).*\[\(.*\)\]/\1/p' | LC_ALL=C sort)" | sha256sum | cut -c1-64
